name: Fast Fuzzy Search – WordPress & WooCommerce Live Search
author: Khizar Hasan

sections.description:
Tired of slow or irrelevant WordPress search results?

Fast Fuzzy Search is a lightweight, privacy-focused plugin that replaces the default WordPress search with an instant, typo-friendly search bar that works out of the box.

Whether you’re running a blog, an online store, or a documentation portal, Fast Fuzzy Search makes sure your visitors find what they’re looking for—fast.

Perfect for:

  • WooCommerce sites
  • Blogs and content-heavy sites
  • Portfolios and project listings
  • Membership or internal knowledge bases
  • Agencies building client sites

Live Demo → Fast Fuzzy Search Live Demo

Features

  • Blazing Fast Fuzzy Search Engine
    Built for typo-tolerant matching, even on massive websites. Your search just got smarter.

  • WooCommerce-Optimized Search
    Search products by name, SKU, category, tags, attributes with the pro version. Works seamlessly with large stores.

  • Live AJAX Search Experience
    No reloads, no lag. Instant results as your visitors type.

  • Product Price & Thumbnail Display
    Show product prices and featured images right inside the search results to boost click-throughs and conversions.

  • Smart Caching for Speed
    Index thousands of posts and products with our blazing fast, file-based cache system.

  • Beautiful, Customizable UI
    Choose from premium-style aesthetics like Minimal, Material, Glassmorphic, or Brutal. Customize colors, position, and layout.

  • Shortcode + Auto Mode
    Drop it anywhere via shortcode or let it auto-render across your site in one click.

  • Multiple Trigger Types
    Use a floating button, input field, icon, or hybrid to open the search panel—your choice, no coding.

  • Responsive & Touch Friendly
    Mobile-ready design that looks amazing and works effortlessly on all screen sizes.

  • Custom Post Type Support
    Search through blog posts, pages, documentation, downloads, properties, and more.

  • Advanced WooCommerce Integration
    Index variations, show prices, and pull in categories, tags, and attributes for ultra-relevant results.

  • Multilingual-Ready
    Localized and compatible with Polylang.

  • Zero External Dependencies
    No CDNs. No trackers. No bloat. 100% self-contained and performance optimized.

Why Fast Fuzzy Search?

  • Instant AJAX Results – Lightning-fast feedback as you type
  • Typo-Tolerant Matching – “blu cap” still finds “blue cap”
  • Fully Self-Hosted – 100% of your data stays on your server
  • Zero Configuration – Just install, activate, and go
  • Works with Polylang – Multilingual support for Latin script languages
  • Lightweight and Performant – Built for speed, optimized for up to 50,000+ posts
  • Built-In Styles – Drop-in themes and styles included

Pro Version ($29)

  • Better integration with WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads, and Easy Property Listings
  • Search by SKU
  • Search by Tags & Categories
  • Search by Attributes (Color, Size, etc.)
  • Premium Themes & Styling
  • Priority support

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Customize the style and behavior under Settings > Fast Fuzzy Search.
  4. Optionally use [fast_fuzzy_search] shortcode to embed the search manually.
sections.faq:
Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes! Fast Fuzzy Search automatically detects and indexes WooCommerce products, including SKUs, categories, tags, attributes, and prices.

Will it slow down my site?

Not at all. It uses a smart caching system and loads asynchronously with no external scripts—built for performance.

Can I use it with a custom post type?

Yes. It supports all public post types by default, and you can choose which ones to index.

Is it better than AJAX Search Pro?

If you’re looking for speed, simplicity, and WooCommerce-ready features out-of-the-box—yes.

How customizable is it?

You can change colors, UI types, positioning, and more with no code.
